app.title: VrcDog

app.select_mode_desc: VrcDog offers two experiences: a desktop management dashboard and an immersive SteamVR built-in overlay.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize your VrcDog experience and preferences
settings.clearCacheDesc: Free up disk space from downloaded worlds and avatars
settings.auth_clear_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear all locally saved credentials and log out? You will need to log in again.
settings.auth_clear_success: Credentials cleared. Please refresh or restart!
settings.debug_console_desc: Show a floating window to monitor API requests and errors
settings.minimize_tray_desc: Hide the app instead of quitting when closed
settings.poll_interval_desc: Shorter is more real-time, but requests more frequently
settings.notify_online_desc: Show desktop notification when a friend comes online
settings.notify_invite_desc: Show VRChat invites directly on your desktop
settings.notify_status_desc: Alert when friend changes status (busy/online/join me)
settings.vrc_cache_desc: Clear downloaded maps and avatars to free C drive space.
settings.discord_desc: Show your VRChat status on your Discord profile
settings.auth_security_desc: VrcDog securely encrypts and stores your VRChat Auth Cookie and Token locally. They are NEVER uploaded to any third-party server. If using a public PC, be sure to clear credentials before leaving.
settings.steamvr_bindings_fail: Failed to open SteamVR bindings panel: {error}
settings.update_latest: You are on the latest version
settings.test_tts_msg: This is a test voice notification
settings.test_notify_msg: This is a test desktop notification! If you see this, notifications are working properly.
settings.software_update_desc: Check and download the latest version of VrcDog
settings.desktop_overlay_desc: Show a draggable quick overlay on the desktop
settings.system_tray_desc: Hide to system tray when minimized
settings.exit_confirm_desc: Show confirmation dialog when clicking the close button
settings.discord_rpc_desc: Show your current VRChat world in your Discord profile
settings.steamvr_register_desc: If VrcDog fails to start with SteamVR, click this to register App Manifest
settings.steamvr_bindings_desc: Open SteamVR controller bindings panel (SteamVR must be running)
settings.vrc_log_parse_desc: Required to see room join/leave events in the Feed page
settings.osc_send_port_desc: Port to send parameters to VRChat (default 9000)
settings.mute_sync_desc: Control microphone using VRChat mute status
settings.sound_notify_desc: Play sound when receiving new messages or friends come online
settings.desktop_notify_desc: Show notification popups in the Windows system tray
settings.tts_desc: Read out game notifications or chat messages
settings.update_info_desc: Keep your VrcDog client up-to-date for the latest features and performance fixes
settings.auto_check_update_desc: Automatically check for new versions in the background when starting the software
settings.vrc_launch_args_desc: These arguments will be appended when launching VRChat or joining an instance through VrcDog.
settings.vrc_cache_clear_desc: Clear VRChat downloaded images, worlds, and avatar caches to free up disk space
settings.db_path_desc: Path to the database file where VrcDog stores local data
settings.vrc_log_path_desc: Select the directory containing output_log files (default: AppData/LocalLow/VRChat/VRChat)
settings.about_p1: VrcDog is an open-source toolset dedicated to improving the VRChat player experience.
settings.about_p2: We provide features such as friend online tracking, world monitoring, game log analysis, multi-language translation, and more.
settings.contribute_desc: This project is completely open-source. Welcome to submit PRs or Issues to help us improve!
settings.top_window_desc: Keep application window always on top
settings.notify_tts_desc: Automatically read aloud important notifications using system voice synthesis
settings.discord_rpc_only_vrc: Only effective when VRChat is running
settings.discord_rpc_conflict_warning: It is recommended to disable native Discord RPC in VRChat's config.json to prevent conflicts
settings.discord_rpc_world_integration_desc: Show "Watching/Listening" status for Popcorn Palace, PyPyDance, VRDancing, and LS Media
settings.discord_rpc_show_room_type: Show room type and player count
settings.discord_rpc_show_private_info: Show room info in private instances
settings.discord_rpc_show_join_btn: Show Join button on profile (Public instances only)
settings.discord_rpc_show_world_name: Show world name in Discord status
